name: ChEBI
rationale: Identity authority for chemical structures. CC BY 4.0 (LICENSE in the SDF directory, ebi.ac.uk/chebi/about) — attribution required, so ChEBI-derived record content cannot be re-dedicated CC0. ChEBI also ships a 3-star-only SDF bulk file that carries exactly the manually curated set and excludes ontology classes by construction; our flat-file path filters for both instead.

name: CARD Antibiotic Resistance Ontology
rationale: Antibiotic molecule subtree, resistance determinants and drug targets. aro.obo/aro.owl are CC BY 4.0 — verified against the arpcard/aro LICENSE, GitHub spdx_id CC-BY-4.0, the OBO Foundry registry and CARD's own download page. Redistributable with credit. Note this is the ONTOLOGY only: card.json is under different, restrictive terms (see card-json).

name: PubChem
rationale: Structure fallback for CARD-only molecules; only CIDs CARD cross-references are fetched. Trap: PubChem CIDs are standardized records, not depositor submissions — 44 percent of deposited structures are modified during standardization — so a CID's InChIKey can differ from the SMILES in the source that supplied it. Treat the CID as PubChem's assertion, not the depositor's.

name: CARD card.json
rationale: BLOCKED on licence, not on value. CARD's terms prohibit reproduction of non-ontology materials by any commercial organization without written McMaster permission, and the academic clause requires the materials be unmodified and credited — conditions that conflict with both harmonization and CC0. The AMR Gene Family / Drug Class / Resistance Mechanism categories live here and are exactly what the mechanism layer wants, so a waiver request to McMaster is the highest-value unblocking action available. Until then the is_a+participates_in walk over the CC BY 4.0 ontology stands, typing 4530 of 4555 rows.

name: MIBiG
rationale: Now the top structural candidate. MIBiG 4.0 is CC BY 4.0 with no restriction on academic or commercial reuse (NAR 2025 Data availability; Zenodo record 14835872 metadata.license.id cc-by-4.0), bulk JSON on Zenodo, and a machine-readable quality/reviewed flag. Caveat to honour at seed time: only about 40 percent of 4.0-cycle entries had passed expert review at publication, and the reviewed flag describes entry curation rather than the strength of the compound-producer link.

name: ChEMBL bioactivities
rationale: Best assay-attached activity source, and it carries CO-ADD's ~100K antimicrobial measurements (src_id 40) with organism, concentration, medium and detection method genuinely attached. But CC BY-SA 3.0 is copyleft: content can be aggregated alongside, never relabelled, and a share-alike obligation would propagate to the whole corpus. Refused for seeding under the corpus's CC BY 4.0 record licence (#27, decided): share-alike would propagate to every downstream user, which CC BY does not. Second trap: a ChEMBL 'parent' is not a guarantee of one component; GetParent leaves genuine mixtures, all-salt records and organometallics unreduced.

name: Stanford HIV Drug Resistance Database
rationale: All 474 antiviral records carry empty resistance_mechanisms because CARD has nothing for viruses; this is the best-curated antiviral resistance resource, HIV only, so HBV/HSV/influenza stay open. Licence VERIFICATION ATTEMPTED AND FAILED on 2026-08-29: hivdb.stanford.edu/pages/FAQ and /page/release-notes render their terms client-side and returned no policy text to a fetch. Stays UNVERIFIED; the next attempt needs a browser or a direct ask, not another blind fetch of those two URLs.

name: NPAtlas
rationale: BLOCKED on licence. npatlas.org/about states verbatim: "The Natural Products Atlas is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-Noncommercial 4.0 International License" (database version 2024_09, checked 2026-08-29). NonCommercial is incompatible with the corpus's CC BY 4.0 record licence — it would restrict every downstream user of this corpus, which CC0 and CC BY 4.0 both refuse to do. Excellent content for a curator to consult; it cannot be seeded. Compare MIBiG, which closes the same gap under CC BY 4.0.

name: CO-ADD
rationale: Reachable through ChEMBL src_id 40 rather than as a separate ingestion — 31 datasets, ~100K measurements, with ASSAY_TEST, CONC, MEDIA and DETECTION_METHOD attached. That means it inherits ChEMBL's CC BY-SA position; check whether CO-ADD's own distribution carries different terms before treating it as an independent option.

name: BV-BRC
rationale: AMR phenotypes with organism, strain and method, but about 93 percent of the rows are machine-learning predictions mixed into the same data type as measured AST results. Any extraction MUST filter on evidence="Laboratory Method" or it silently ingests model output as measurement — the same class of error as honouring ChEBI's unreviewed relation edges.

name: BacDive
rationale: Strain-level susceptibility from DSMZ. Sibling repos already consume BacDive, so the access pattern is known here.

name: DrugCentral
rationale: clinical_status is unset on every record; DrugCentral carries approval status and route with dates.

name: WHO ATC and AWaRe
rationale: ATC codes and the AWaRe Access/Watch/Reserve classification are what clinicians filter on. WHO publication terms need checking before anything is redistributed.

name: ChEBI entry citations
rationale: Already extracted into a citations column that nothing reads. A ChEBI entry's references support the COMPOUND, not necessarily an antimicrobial claim about it, so seeding them into evidence needs a stated rule first.

name: LOTUS
rationale: Natural-product occurrences linked to taxa, built on Wikidata. Overlaps NPAtlas; adopt one first and measure what the second adds.

name: COCONUT
rationale: Aggregated natural-product structures. Value here is coverage for minted records that have no ChEBI entry.

name: Norine
rationale: Nonribosomal peptides with monomer-level representation. Sharpened by a verified finding: the Standard InChIKey does not recognise some 1,5 keto-enol tautomers as the same compound, cannot express cis/trans in organometallics, and does not support relative stereochemistry — all live risks for macrocyclic peptides, where our identity model keys on exactly that hash.

name: ClassyFire and NPClassifier
rationale: Computed structural classes would give structural_class to the records CARD does not cover. Computed, not asserted, so it needs its own provenance marker.

name: antiSMASH database
rationale: Predicted clusters across sequenced genomes. Predictions are not evidence of production; useful for leads, not for seeding.

name: MEGARes
rationale: Resistance gene database with its own ontology. Largely overlaps CARD; adopt only if it covers determinants CARD misses.

name: DrugBank
rationale: Excellent data, but the licence does not permit redistribution in a CC0 knowledge base. Usable as a curator reference only, never seeded.

name: KEGG DRUG
rationale: Same shape of problem as DrugBank: freely readable, not freely redistributable. ChEBI already carries kegg.compound and kegg.drug cross-references, which is the useful half.

name: CLSI breakpoint standards
rationale: Paywalled standards documents. A curator may consult them; the corpus cannot carry them.

name: EUCAST breakpoint tables
rationale: Freely downloadable clinical breakpoints, but they are species-level clinical cut-offs rather than measured MICs — a different claim from what activity_spectrum models.

name: ChEBI mechanism roles
rationale: The cheapest close available, and it was missing from this queue entirely: mode_of_action is 0% and had NO candidate source. ChEBI already asserts mechanism-shaped roles on compounds we already read — 765 of the 2623 ChEBI-sourced records bear at least one via reviewed edges (protein synthesis inhibitor 44, DNA synthesis inhibitor 26, sterol 14-alpha-demethylase inhibitor 25, dihydropteroate synthase inhibitor 11, topoisomerase inhibitors, HIV RT/integrase/protease inhibitors, sialidase). Same source, same licence, same extraction path, no new network dependency. NOT a regex job: the same role space also holds angiogenesis, apoptosis and platelet-aggregation inhibitors, which are host-directed and irrelevant here, so it needs a curated role-to-ModeOfActionEnum allowlist exactly like role_to_class.

name: Discovery and review literature
rationale: Present so the gap is visible rather than absent. causal_graphs is 0% and is the thing this repository exists to hold, but it is not ingestible from any database: a mechanism graph is curator-authored from primary literature, one compound at a time, with every edge carrying its own citation. Listed as REFERENCE to record that no source will close this column and the work belongs in NEXT_TASKS, not here.
